title: Visas & Entry
items: Apply online for an e-Visa (www.evisa.gov.kh) — $30, valid 30 days.
Visa on arrival available at airports and major land borders — bring a passport photo and USD cash.
Passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond arrival.

title: Best Time to Visit
items: November – February: cool, dry season — the best weather for temples and beaches.
March – May: hot season, up to 40°C, but fewer crowds.
June – October: rainy season with lush landscapes and short afternoon downpours.

title: Getting Around
items: Tuk-tuks are the standard city transport — use the Grab or PassApp apps for fair prices.
Siem Reap to Phnom Penh: 6 hours by bus ($10–15) or 40 minutes by flight.
Motorbike rentals widely available ($5–10/day) — always wear a helmet.

title: Money & Costs
items: USD is used for large amounts; Cambodian Riel for small change (≈ 4,000 Riel = $1).
Angkor Wat ticket: 37/dayor37/day or37/dayor62 for 3 days — buy at the official Angkor Ticket Center.
